title: Anime
look: Modern TV anime: flat cel colour, one hard shadow, a thin coloured line, big eyes.

doc.essence: A character from a current TV anime: a bigger head on a smaller body, tall eyes that hold most of the face, colour laid down in two flat tones.
doc.notIt: Not flat (a hard shadow tone and a line), not manga (colour, no screentone), not cel-anime-80s (rounder, shorter, glossy round eyes, smooth fills).
doc.shapes: Super-deformed proportions: the head grows, the body and limbs shrink and thin towards the ends. A thin line tinted from the body colour, never pure black.
doc.colour: Cel paint: every area is its colour plus one hard-edged shadow tone across the lower right, slightly cooler than the base.
doc.eyes: Tall eyes with a white, a layered iris (darker on top, lighter at the bottom, a pupil), two highlights and a heavy upper lash line that flicks out at the corner. Short thin brows, a tiny mouth. Sweat drop on surprise, hatched blush lines when happy.
doc.motion: Limited animation: each pose holds, then snaps quickly to the next.
pitfalls: The hold-then-snap timing makes fast actions look abrupt; that is the look, keep actions readable at the held poses.
Big eyes crowd small faces: keep the face scale so the eyes stay inside the head.
